CustomField.formula:
CASE( TEXT(LicenseType__r.RenewalMailToCode__c) , "B - Business Mailing/Business/Residence", IF( IsMailingPopulated__c = "Y", TEXT(MailingState__c), IF(IsBusinessPopulated__c = "Y", TEXT(BusinessState__c), ResidenceState__c)),
"R - Residence Mailing/Residence", IF( IsMailingPopulated__c = "Y", TEXT(MailingState__c), IF(IsResidencePopulated__c = "Y", ResidenceStateCode__c, null)),
"E - Employer If licensee is inactive, licensee’s Mailing/Residence. Otherwise, c/o Employer’s Mailing/Business", IF(
OR ( TEXT(ActiveInactive__c) = "Inactive", IsEmployerAddressPopulated__c = "N" ),
IF( IsMailingPopulated__c = "Y", TEXT(MailingState__c), IF(IsResidencePopulated__c = "Y", ResidenceStateCode__c, null)),
TEXT(EmployerState__c)
),
NULL)
CustomField.label: Renewal Mail To State
